cpi.description: Consumer Price Index, all groups, index numbers
cpi.title: Consumer Price Index, Australia
cpi.notes: Monthly from 2024-04. Quarterly from 1948-Q3 (Darwin from 1980-Q3). Regions are capital cities; 'australia' is the weighted average of the eight capitals.

cpi_rents.description: Consumer Price Index, rents expenditure class, index numbers
cpi_rents.title: Consumer Price Index, Australia
cpi_rents.notes: Monthly from 2022-07 for all regions. Quarterly (from 1972-Q3) and seasonally adjusted (monthly) for 'australia' only. Rents are measured net of Commonwealth Rent Assistance, so they are not market asking rents.

wpi.description: Wage Price Index, total hourly rates of pay excluding bonuses, all sectors and industries
wpi.title: Wage Price Index, Australia
wpi.notes: Quarterly from 1997-Q3. Regions are states and territories. Seasonally adjusted and trend series exist for 'australia' only.

cash_rate.title: Cash rate target
cash_rate.notes: Monthly from 1990-08 (table F1.1), as the average of the daily target over the month, so a month with a change shows a blend such as 4.36. Daily from 2011-01-04 (table F1). For the dates of changes, use get_rba('A2', 'ARBAMPCNCRT').
